text:
maria: Heads up — we've got a steady memory climb on long streaming sessions (tool-loop + chat) on prod-2. Heap increases ~200MB/hour on sessions >60k tokens, doesn't go back down between turns. Not seeing OOMs yet but p99 latency creeping. Anyone seen this pattern?
noah: repro steps? model, kernel, batching config?
maria: repro: run long chat toolloop with 5 parallel sessions on host-prod-2, model = open-model-xl, sequence distribution skewed to 1 big turn per session. Serving runtime picks 'spatial-kernel-large' for those batches. TL;DR: mem climbs when kernel_variant=spatial-kernel-large + batching enabled.
sam: interesting — we saw a similar shape but assumed refcount drift. quick checks: jemalloc stats show increased retained but not active growth; pmap shows lots of anonymous mappings pinned in 64MB-aligned pages. suspect page-aligned KV slabs not being coalesced after eviction.
infra-bot: alert: memory-residency-prod-2 increased 18% over 3 hours (triggered at 4781234570).
lena: can you paste the minimal repro command? I can run on staging.
maria: repro cmd: 
```
./run_infer --model=open-model-xl --sessions=5 --max_turn_length=12000 --tool-loop --batcher=auto --max_batch_tokens=32768
```
also captured perf flame: http://internal.perf/fg/4781234567 (private link) — shows heavy kernel time in attention-kernel + slow free paths.
sam: two hypotheses: 1) batching heuristic picks large-batch path that allocates big KV pages and then evicts weirdly -> fragmentation; 2) kernel uses an allocator path that pins pages (madvise/MLOCK?) for perf and we don't unpin on compact. Quick mitigation: force small-kernel path or lower max_batch_tokens to 8192 to avoid large-page allocation.
noah: can we try a config toggle to force compact kernel on prod-2 for a subset of traffic? If it stabilizes, we can roll more.
lena: i'll spin a staging run forcing KERNEL_PREFERENCE=compact and max_batch_tokens=8192, will post results in ~30m.
sam: temporary code patch idea: call kv.background_compact_if_idle() in the session teardown path and add a defensive call after eviction to call madvise(DONTNEED) on freed pages. pseudo: 
```
if (session.idle_for > 30s) kv.compact_if_idle();
// on eviction path
page->madvise(DONTNEED);
```
We should be careful — madvise might regress latency. Add as opt-in flag.
maria: i'll run the staging repro with compact kernel + kv.compact in a canary container and collect jemalloc retained/active and pmap snapshots.
noah: assign to maria + sam for triage. If staging shows >50% reduction in retained, we'll do canary rollback plan: roll to 5% traffic with compact kernel and monitor 2 hours. @lena please hold the staging logs. :thumbsup:
maria: noted. I'll post the first staging run outputs here. Thanks everyone.
noah: FYI, add a short-term dashboard widget for 'kv_retained_bytes' and 'large-page-count' so ops can watch if we flip kernel or batching heuristics.
maria: ack, updating dashboard after first run.
